pr_title: Implement negative for OmniLights and SpotLights in GLES2
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/30983

~~Directional light already worked because it is computed in the base pass. OmniLights and Spotlights are computed in accumulation pass, so they need to use subtraction instead of addition.~~

Reverse color on base pass, use blend_subtract instead of blend_add for other passes.

issue_context.title: Negative spotlight not working in GLES 2
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.1.1 stable


**OS/device including version:**
GNU/Linux x64


**Issue description:**
Negative spotlights don't seem to be implemented for the GLES2 renderer

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[SpotlightTest.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/3449164/SpotlightTest.zip)

review_comments: This looks strange, where does it get reset?

In the line above. 

``blend_mode`` is redefined for every object. If it happens to be an ``accum_pass`` the default blend mode is overridden to ``BLEND MODE ADD`` in 2311. All I did was check to see if its a negative light and change that override to be ``BLEND_MODE_SUB``
oh i see, makes sense, seems fine then
